# JoyType

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Joystick](BlitzBasic-Joystick)

</div>


```blitzbasic
JoyType:Int32 port:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `port` | In | Int32 | `0` | The joystick to ask, counted from 0. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** 0 if there is no joystick, 1 for a gamepad and 2 for any other joystick.

## Description

Tells whether a joystick is connected to the port and what kind it is.

## Differences

* The original uses 1 for a digital and 2 for an analog joystick. Here a device that SDL recognizes as a gamepad is 1 and everything else is 2.
* Up to 4 joysticks get a port, in the order they are found. One that is plugged in later takes the next port that was never used (once all 4 were used, it is not noticed), and one that is removed leaves its port empty (see [JoyDeviceConnected](JoyDeviceConnected)).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For p = 0 To 3
	Select JoyType(p)
		Case 0 : t$ = "not connected"
		Case 1 : t$ = "gamepad"
		Default : t$ = "other joystick"
	End Select
	Text 10, 10 + p * 16, "Port " + p + ": " + t$
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
